page.overview:
What is Asgorath?

Asgorath (), more commonly known as Io in the Outer Planes, of creation. were regarded by some as the creator of the multiverse and of dragonkind, and they manipulated the destinies of all dragons by operating in a way that nobody suspected their involvement. Asgorath was supposed to encompass all alignments, but was often regarded as neutral, and their holy symbol, an unadorned circle, represented totality.

While the sarrukhs believed that Asgorath was an aspect of the World Serpent, some scholars argued that they were actually a primordial who was worshipped as a deity in the draconic pantheon. It was possible that Asgorath was similar to Ao, a kind of all-powerful yet detached overgod.

Asgorath was an omnipotent dragon god. Although they never manifested themself before their worshipers, they made their existence felt as a powerful presence in their minds.

Asgorath, however, could manifest physically if they wanted to, taking on the form of any dragon, and even in forms of other draconic creatures, such as pseudodragons. The oldest myths of dragonkind claimed that Asgorath manifested physically only once, during the act of creating the cosmos. Those who believed in this myth believed Asgorath was so huge, that even their scales were larger than the largest mortal dragon that ever existed.
